competing_explanation: Equal image dimensions or generic natural-image correlation alone cannot establish pixel registration. The observed zero-displacement result was accompanied by valid cyclic wrong-clear controls for every pair, valid fixed eight-pixel shift controls for every pair, and exact recovery of three data-free known-shift fixtures through the same scoring path. These controls reject the predeclared size-only and broad-correlation explanations within the tested integer-displacement design, but they do not establish photometric equivalence or subpixel calibration.
limitations: This qualification establishes spatial correspondence only after the frozen ten-pixel center crop of each clear image; it does not authorize uncropped clear-hazy scoring.
The displacement search covered integer dx and dy from -4 through +4 with fixed eight-pixel negative controls; subpixel offsets and deformations outside that design were not estimated.
The Rec.709 luminance-gradient score is a registration qualification signal, not PSNR, SSIM, restoration quality, or model performance.
